title: Ergothioneine suppresses hepatic stellate cell activation via promoting Foxa3-dependent potentiation of the Hint1/Smad7 cascade and improves CCl(4)-induced liver fibrosis in mice.
authors: Shu, Guangwen; Lei, Xiao; Li, Guangqiong; Zhang, Tiantian; Wang, Chuo; Song, Anning; Yu, Huifan; Wang, Xiaoming; Deng, Xukun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究麦角硫因通过Foxa3调控Hint1/Smad7通路抑制肝星状细胞活化，涉及Foxa3-DNA启动子结合预测和分子对接，但核心是肝纤维化药理机制，非TF-DNA互作建模方法研究。
abstract: Ergothioneine (EGT) is a bioactive compound derived from certain edible mushrooms. The activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) is critically involved in the etiology of liver fibrosis (LF). Here, we report that in LX-2 HSCs, EGT upregulates the expression of Hint1 and Smad7 and suppresses their activation provoked by TGFbeta1. The EGT-triggered inhibition of HSC activation is abolished by knocking down the expression of Hint1. Overexpression of Hint1 increases Smad7 and represses TGFbeta1-provoked activation of LX-2 HSCs. In silico predictions unveiled that in the promoter region of the human Hint1 gene, there are two conserved cis-acting elements that have the potential to interact with the transcription factor Foxa3 termed hFBS1 and hFBS2, respectively. The knockdown of Foxa3 obviously declined Hint1 expression at both mRNA and protein levels. Transfection of Foxa3 or EGT treatment increased the activity of the luciferase reporter driven by the Hint1 promoter in an hFBS2-dependent manner. The knockdown of Foxa3 eliminated EGT-mediated upregulation of Hint1 promoter activity. Additionally, EGT triggered the nuclear translocation of Foxa3 without obviously affecting its expression level. Molecular docking analysis showed that EGT has the potential to directly interact with the Foxa3 protein. Moreover, Foxa3 played a critical role in EGT-mediated hepatoprotection. EGT modulated the Foxa3/Hint1/Smad7 signaling in mouse primary HSCs and inhibited their activation. The gavage of EGT considerably relieved CCl(4)-induced LF in mice. Our data provide new insights into the anti-LF activity of EGT. Mechanistically, EGT triggers the nuclear translocation of Foxa3 in HSCs, which promotes Hint1 transcription and subsequently elevates Smad7.
abstract_zh: 麦角硫因（Ergothioneine, EGT）是一种源自某些食用菌的生物活性化合物。肝星状细胞（hepatic stellate cells, HSCs）的活化在肝纤维化（liver fibrosis, LF）的病因学中至关重要。在此，我们报道在LX-2 HSCs中，EGT上调Hint1和Smad7的表达，并抑制由TGFbeta1诱导的细胞活化。敲低Hint1的表达可消除EGT触发的HSC活化抑制作用。Hint1的过表达增加Smad7并抑制TGFbeta1诱导的LX-2 HSCs活化。计算机模拟预测揭示，在人类Hint1基因的启动子区域，存在两个保守的顺式作用元件，分别命名为hFBS1和hFBS2，它们具有与转录因子Foxa3相互作用的潜力。Foxa3的敲低明显降低了Hint1在mRNA和蛋白质水平的表达。转染Foxa3或EGT处理以hFBS2依赖性方式增加了由Hint1启动子驱动的荧光素酶报告基因活性。Foxa3的敲低消除了EGT介导的Hint1启动子活性上调。此外，EGT触发Foxa3的核转位，而不明显影响其表达水平。分子对接分析显示，EGT具有直接与Foxa3蛋白相互作用的潜力。此外，Foxa3在EGT介导的肝脏保护中发挥关键作用。EGT调节小鼠原代HSCs中的Foxa3/Hint1/Smad7信号通路，并抑制其活化。EGT灌胃显著缓解了CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝纤维化。我们的数据为EGT的抗肝纤维化活性提供了新见解。机制上，EGT触发HSCs中Foxa3的核转位，从而促进Hint1转录，并随后升高Smad7。
